name: Shimanto (Japan, city)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Shimanto city emblem in blue and light blue: a blue oval with light blue curved strokes, like a river.
history: Municipal flag of Shimanto, a city in Kōchi Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 29 November 2005.
